Processing
FLAC encoding described by the upstream collection as 32 bits per sample Documented

This is the collection’s own description of its encoding, not verification of the source recording’s capture resolution or of restoration processing. Commons supplies the FLAC from which its MP3 derivative is served.

[3]
Composition rights
Public domain, as stated in the separate Commons musical-composition notice Documented

The composition notice is separate from Musopen’s release of the sound recording; it does not describe the rights of a modern score edition.

[1]
Recording rights
Rule 1 — recording release: PD-author public-domain dedication by Musopen. Documented

Commons explicitly applies PD-author by Musopen to the recording, separately from the composition. This is the programme’s explicit Musopen recording-release route, not an age-based inference or a claim that a Public Domain Mark is itself a licence. The session date is not needed for this route.
